evidence.reviewer_disagreement_reviewed: The skeptic pushed on the most tempting adjacent change: since a verified 5.0 from 7 ratings now exists, why not emit aggregateRating and win a star snippet. Answered rather than deferred. A rating collected on Google and asserted by the subject about itself is self-serving structured data, ineligible for review rich results and a documented manual-action risk. The PR therefore adds a regression test that pins the ABSENCE of aggregateRating and review nodes, so a later pass cannot quietly add them. The taste reviewer raised a second point, that Person.workLocation listed two counties while LocalBusiness.areaServed listed three; the narrower node was corrected rather than the wider one loosened, because the live profile service area was confirmed as three counties by re-reading it after the change.
evidence.winner_rationale: sameAs is the schema.org-sanctioned way to attach a third-party record to an entity, and it is the only mechanism here that does entity disambiguation without asserting anything about ourselves. The alternative considered and rejected was embedding the rating directly. Storing the URL on the site config object rather than inline in the schema module keeps one source of truth for the profile link and lets a test assert the exact value.

booking_or_authority_thesis: The site does not own its own name: the brand query esteban moreno media sits at position 6.6 with zero clicks over 2026-07-15 to 08-11, against 463 impressions and 2 clicks sitewide. A verified profile now holding 7 ratings at 5.0 is the strongest authority signal this business has, and nothing declared the link between it and the domain. sameAs is that declaration. This does not claim to move commercial rankings, which sit at position 35 to 68 and have a different cause.
